objective: Phase 1D: Forecast Engine - Pure deterministic 14-day cash-flow forecast domain calculations, boundary dates, leap days, contributor attribution, and zero double-counting
acceptance_criteria: Implement pure domain forecast engine in backend/app/domain/forecast.py
Given start date, opening cash in paise, inflows, outflows, safety buffer, and horizon days, returns exact day-by-day projected closing balances
Closing balance formula strictly matches: closing[d] = opening[d] + inflows[d] - outflows[d]
Breach flags: below_zero (closing < 0) and below_safety_buffer (closing < buffer)
Contributor references attached to each day with source_type, source_id, description, and amount_paise
Avoid double-counting: filter out any movement already reflected in opening balance or dated prior to forecast start
Domain unit tests covering month boundaries (e.g. Feb 28/29 to Mar 1), leap days, same-day multiple movements, and zero-movement days
Forecast API route updated to call domain forecast engine directly
All tests pass and frontend build succeeds

evidence.pytest: 26 passed in 0.52s (test_api.py, test_forecast.py, test_ledger.py, test_money.py, test_suppliers_expenses.py)

non_goals: Do not call external AI/LLM for forecast calculation (deterministic Python only)
Do not mutate actual database records
